name: Abstract Art Showcase
tagline: Cream-gallery art deck with heavy condensed titles, calligraphic script, black editorial rules, and green biomorphic artwork.

palette.description: Warm off-white paper, black typography and rules, moss green art-object accents, pale gray panels, and quiet olive highlights.

typography.style: Tall black uppercase display type with Tangerine script overlays and tiny gallery labels.

best_for: Art exhibitions, gallery walkthroughs, cultural programming, and expressive creative reports that need editorial restraint.
avoid_for: Plain corporate operating reviews, legal briefings, or dense technical documentation.

source_inspiration.name: Slidesgo Abstract Art Showcase
source_inspiration.notes: Rebuilt as source-inspired portable HTML/CSS from public visual references; no source asset files are embedded.
